e: Awarded each year by CASCA and the Royal Astronomical Society of Canada for the most outstanding doctoral thesis in astronomy or astrophysics by a PhD graduate of a Canadian university within the last two calendar years. The department head nominates at most one candidate, who must be (or have been for two years during the PhD) a CASCA member in good standing.
